config.grain_rationale: One row per ACNC-registered charity; the record describes the registered legal entity plus the single contact address it lodged with the ACNC. ABN is not guaranteed unique (duplicates/blanks occur), so record identity is content-derived.

record_id.rationale: ABN is blank in ~0.6% of rows and repeats for some entities, so it is not a reliable unique key; hash the full record content instead.

fields.rationale: Column explicitly named Charity_Legal_Name on the ACNC register = registered legal name.
Other names the charity is known by (trading/display names), explicitly separate from the legal name column.
ABN column; 100% checksum-valid in discovery, 1173/1173 held-out values passed.

Charity_Website mixes bare domains, http(s) URLs and free text. Fix for hold-out WEBSITE_INVALID: extract the FIRST URL/domain token, then hard-validate that the token as a whole is a URL/domain, so multi-URL prose blobs drop instead of erroring.
ACNC registration date; DD/MM/YYYY confirmed by the 03/12/2012 ACNC-commencement spike. Does not fall back to Date_Organisation_Established.

Address lines combined into ONE contact address. Address_Type is uniformly 'Business' and values include PO boxes ('Po Box 576'), venue names ('Egan Park', 'Community Centre') and locality-only entries, so this is a postal/contact address, not confirmed premises. Confidence lowered to 0.55 because postal-vs-premises is unresolvable from this source; structured locality/state/postcode are mapped separately from their own columns.
Town/city (suburb) field; case preserved as sourced.
Australian state abbreviations; trimmed first so held-out 'SA ' normalises; unknown maps to OTHER.
4-digit AU postcodes. Hold-out rejects were a 5-digit '80571' and a town name 'Cloverdale'; a strict 4-digit token extraction now drops those rows rather than erroring.

Critic fix: address.country emits ONLY 'AU'. The register is Australian (ACNC) and its non-AU Country values are demonstrably source errors (hold-out row 2: Country='Austria' on a VIC/3025/AUS record). A row-level 'when' gate restricts emission to recognised Australian spellings, so 'Austria', 'Singapore' and 'WA 6105' are left unmapped for that row instead of being emitted as a country or raising ENUM_UNMAPPED.

unmapped.reason: Single constant value 'Business' (480/480). No ontology target, but it is the evidence qualifier for address.full: it confirms the address block is a business/contact address, and with PO boxes/venue names it shows postal-vs-premises cannot be resolved.

ISO3 comma list of countries of OPERATION (AUS dominant; also IDN, PNG, NPL), 84.2% present. Critic suggested it as an address.country fallback. Deliberately not mapped: it describes where the charity operates, not where its address is; and since address.country is now AU-only, using an operation list as fallback would inject foreign values into an address field. Only 10/386 values are multi-country, so there is no reliable single-value mapping either.
Near-miss flagged for lineage: date the organisation was founded, NOT ACNC registration. Rows with a missing Registration_Date must not be back-filled from this column, so it stays unmapped.

ACNC revenue-size band (Small/Medium/Large). Explicit ontology gap: it is a genuine entity-classification attribute with no canonical home (entity.industry_code is a category error). Flagged for ontology extension rather than forced into a wrong target.
Governance headcount; no ontology target.
Reporting period fit (e.g. 30-Jun); not a valid_from/valid_to date.
State operation flag; address.state comes from the registered address, not operation footprint.

config.notes: Hold-out fixes: (1) entity.website — the invalid value was a prose blob containing two URLs and a parenthesised domain; now the first URL/domain token is extracted and hard-validated, so blobs drop instead of erroring (no error observed on discovery). (2) address.postcode — hold-out rejects were '80571' (5 digits) and 'Cloverdale' (a town); a strict 4-digit token extraction now leaves those rows unmapped rather than erroring. (3) address.country — formerly passthrough, which emitted 'AUSTRIA' for a record whose State/Postcode/Operating_Countries are all Australian; now gated by a row-level 'when' on recognised Australian spellings and emitted only as 'AU', so non-AU values (source typos) are left unmapped for that row. Judgement calls I did NOT change: Operating_Countries stays unmapped (it is countries of operation, not address country — using it as an address fallback would be a category error and would re-inject foreign values now that the field is AU-only); Charity_Size stays unmapped as a stated ontology gap (no valid target; entity.industry_code would be wrong); Date_Organisation_Established flagged as a lineage near-miss so nobody back-fills date_registered from it; Address_Type documented as the postal-vs-premises qualifier explaining address.full's lowered confidence (0.55). entity.status not mapped: no per-row status column. entity_type not mapped: suffixes in the name are text, not a structured type field. No per-row observation date; fallback to resource last-modified.
